semantics: Only observed loaded historical faulted tiles are imported; unloaded world data are not scanned or certified.

Known unresolved contexts retain their exact target and do not widen. Unlinked/missing/malformed context becomes an explicit legacy-unknown record with observed host coordinates, never inferred original target or mutation phase.
Unknown historical mutation fences its observed owner in the current dimension. Missing owner fences all owners in that dimension. Other known-owner partitions stay separate.
Original malformed context/prior-evidence payloads remain preserved and sealed. No provider callbacks, automatic replay/redemption/minting or fence-clear operation is added.
Capacity exhaustion preserves the full previous journal and unlocated fault in an opaque envelope; round-trip native tests verify it cannot silently reopen.
Pre-existing loose unlinked receipts remain unauthenticated and operator-inspected; their original owner/target cannot be synthesized.

Generated historical faults were written by real pinned pre-journal native runtimes, then imported and reloaded in two candidate JVMs. This is not an arbitrary modpack/user-world or provider-private durability claim.

resolved_failures.cause: The fixture reset cleared the journal before removing prior faulted hosts. Their removal now correctly imports a durable unknown-route barrier, contaminating the next disposable case.
resolved_failures.repair: Clear the test-only journal again after old tiles/entities are removed; production persistence remains intact.

resolved_failures.cause: NBTTagCompound equality in this runtime includes the root tag name; copying payloads under named evidence fields changed that name.
resolved_failures.repair: Compare full copied NBT payloads under a shared canonical root in the fixture; do not discard evidence.

resolved_failures.cause: The new malformed-context test reached a real native ReportedException/ClassCastException because getCompoundTag was called before checking NBT type.
resolved_failures.repair: Both tile loading and held-receipt inspection type-check first; preserve raw malformed context/evidence and require unauthenticated/manual inspection instead of decoding.

review_finding.finding: A full-journal fallback that leaves valid schema2 entries at the root can be parsed on reload while ignoring the extra unlocated fault. Found in source review before final qualification.
